_comment: Task 2.3: the Horns' camp, attached to ruin_surface's `ceria_dig_camp` NPC. A SEPARATE graph file, not nodes inside ceria_intro.json: a graph is one file (game.gd keys dialogue_graphs by basename) and always opens at its own `start`, with no per-entity start-node override, so camp_hub could never be reached through ceria_intro's hub. The split is also what the place-naming validator wants -- the horns_dig GIVER maps stay disjoint from the join_dig PRODUCER map. SPOILER RULE: no line here names a door; the reveal is the pedestal's open_toast. NO door_retrieved arm lives here: the camp survives the whole haul window, so a past-tense arm would be wrong while the haul is still running; spec 8's past-tense arm stays on ceria_intro's hub.

camp_hub.speaker: Ceria
camp_hub.text: You made it. Camp rules: nobody touches anything shiny, nobody wanders past the survey stakes alone. The sealed level's below the pedestal court. We found the site off an old expedition ledger — half the pages were about what they DIDN'T bring out.

camp_fourth._comment: #349 four-member reading, camp side: the crate's rations for four, the notes' four names and the remnant's four bedroll squares all already count him. This is the line that says WHO and WHY he isn't holding a shovel. Ungated on purpose -- a player who never asks still reads the count in the props, and a player who asks gets it straight. SPOILER RULE holds: no line here names a door.
camp_fourth.speaker: Ceria
camp_fourth.text: Pisces. He's ours, whatever he tells you about invoices, and he's back in the city with his nose in a treatise — which is exactly where I want him. Four names on the roster, three of us with shovels. He turns up when there's something down here worth reading, and not one hour before.
